author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸೋತುಹೋಗಿಹ ಮನಕೆ ಸಾಂತ್ವನ ಬೇಕಿಂದು
ಆತುಕೊಳೆ ಭುಜಬೇಕು ನೋವುಂಡ ಜನಕೆ
ಸೇತುವೆಯು ನೀನಾಗೆ ಒಡೆದಮನಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯೆ
ಮಾತುಗಳೆ ಮೂಲಿಕೆಯು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: A defeated mind needs comfort today;
those who have suffered need a shoulder to lean on;
when you become a bridge between broken hearts,
words themselves are the healing herb, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Hurting people need consolation and a shoulder to lean on. Be a bridge between broken hearts; kind words are the medicine.
